items.title: 1.2 Network architecture aur bunyadi tasawwurat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.2 (PDF 7-8), paragraph for paragraph; our packet figure and a tip on packets, two self-checks and a recap.

blocks.text: Network architecture computer network ka mukammal design hai. Yeh dikhati hai ke computers, servers aur doosre devices kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain (jaise Figure 1.2 mein). Yeh yeh bhi tay karti hai ke network par data kaise bheja jata hai. Network architecture mein hardware, software aur baat-cheet ke qawaid (rules) shamil hain. Achhi architecture network ko achhi tarah chalne mein madad deti hai. Yeh network ko aage barhane (future expansion) mein bhi madad deti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar Internet ka badal (cloud) Wi-Fi lehron wale wireless router se jura hai; router se shakhon wali cable neeche desktop computer, laptop, server rack, tablet aur printer tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.2: Network architecture dikhati hai ke network mein devices aur hisse kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain (kitab ki Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Devices ki tasveerein ya naam diye jayein. Talaba device ke naam ko us ke kaam se milayein. Phir jawabon par baat karein.

Network ek device se doosre device tak data bhej kar kaam karta hai. Bhejne se pehle data chhote hisson mein toot jata hai jinhein packets kehte hain. Yeh packets cables ya wireless signals se safar karte hain. Networking devices packets ko sahi manzil (destination) tak pohanchate hain. Wusool karne wala device packets ko dobara jor kar asal data bana deta hai. Is tarah baat-cheet hamwaar (smooth) aur tez hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Upar 'HELLO CLASS XII' asal data; yeh numbered packets 1 HELLO, 2 CLASS, 3 XII mein toota jata, cable ya wireless se safar karta, badli tarteeb (2, 1, 3) mein pohanch sakta, aur numbers se dobara jor kar receiver ke paas wahi 'HELLO CLASS XII' ban jata hai.
blocks.caption: Data packets mein toot kar safar karta aur receiver par dobara jurta hai (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Data ko packets mein torne ka faida: bohat se devices ek hi link share kar sakte hain, aur agar koi packet raaste mein gum ho jaye to sirf wahi packet dobara bheja jata hai, poora data nahi.

blocks.prompt: Network architecture kya hai, aur is mein kaun si teen cheezein shamil hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh network ka mukammal design hai: devices kaise tarteeb diye gaye aur data kaise bheja jata hai. Is mein hardware, software aur baat-cheet ke qawaid shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Bhejne se pehle data packets mein kyun toota jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhote packets network ke links doosre traffic ke saath share kar sakte, har aik ko manzil tak rehnumai mil sakti, aur gum hone par alag se dobara bheje ja sakte hain; receiver unhein jor kar asal data bana deta hai.

items: Architecture: devices ki tarteeb aur data bhejne ka tareeqa; hardware, software aur qawaid.
Data packets mein toot kar jata hai aur receiver par dobara jurta hai.
